primary: Mass RMSE after256 pairs including ALL learning queries, with paired independent histories and all simple/nonlinear controls retained.
adaptation: Adaptive methods start with identity coupling. Fit surrogates and coupling using only earlier complete batches. New Gaussian draws are independent of history. Do not remap old draws with updated parameters; retain all target values in the final normalizer sums.
scope: Known-probability COM toy;32 independent history seeds per case, fixed512 total target evaluations per method/history. Learned coupling can alter only within-batch covariance, not reference marginals. Standard adaptive-IS/martingale logic, not claimed novel. No new molecular calls or molecular-generation claim.
